summary: 53/53 automated tests passed. All fourteen software capabilities are mapped below; institutional dependencies are listed separately.

labs.title: Planning and revision
labs.behavior: Clarify missing inputs, preview objectives and revise before locking.

labs.title: Typed tool use
labs.behavior: Evidence queries and integer-INR calculations use governed tools.

labs.title: Reusable skills
labs.behavior: Typed planning and package-formatting skills work across topics and reject invalid outputs.

labs.title: Memory and retrieval
labs.behavior: Checkpoint state is separate from tagged, similarity-ranked institutional history.
labs.limit: Similarity uses lexical hashing embeddings; full-text scientific review is still required.

labs.title: Governed connector
labs.behavior: Authenticated typed endpoints and scoped evidence access centralize source retrieval.
labs.limit: MCP-style interface; not an MCP wire-protocol server.

labs.title: Runtime and recovery
labs.behavior: Persist execution state, audit actions and recover the checkpoint in a new process.

labs.title: Executable node graph
labs.behavior: Run discovery, literature, drafting, budget, compliance, validation and human review.
labs.limit: LLM success here uses controlled HTTP response fixtures; verify an installed model using Check model response.

labs.title: Parallel work and merge
labs.behavior: Both graph branches execute concurrently and candidate ranking matches serial scoring.
labs.limit: Concurrency is verified. The earlier seven-item CPU benchmark was slower with threads; production latency improvement is not asserted.

labs.title: Evidence grounding
labs.behavior: Retain citation provenance and reject unknown model-generated evidence IDs.
labs.limit: Citations are structurally checked; authenticity, scientific truth and novelty require named-human review.

labs.title: Diagnosis and bounded repair
labs.behavior: Repair a miscomputed total without changing original costs; escalate unrepairable evidence failures.

labs.title: Tested acceptance gate
labs.behavior: Reject plan drift and invalid budgets; build no package until every required check passes.

labs.title: Governance and rollback
labs.behavior: Enforce reviewer roles, exact-package approval, revision invalidation and restored-version exports.

labs.title: Funding-profile specialists
labs.behavior: Use government, industry and international framing with selected-call numerical requirements.
labs.limit: Actual agency norms and required forms must be entered from official sources.

labs.title: Integrated office workflow
labs.behavior: Complete the authenticated create, validate, review and export cycle.
labs.limit: Software integration is tested. College acceptance on a genuine current call, live model quality, native Windows deployment and actual agency submission are not certified by automated tests.
